notes.title: 🏥 Age-65 Insurance Cliff
notes.body: Medicare does not travel. Shop GeoBlue Xplorer Premier or Cigna Global Platinum 6 months before departure. The age-65 premium is roughly double the age-56 premium — combined coverage runs ~$1,550/month including a MEDEVAC rider, and is the single largest non-haul cost in the budget.

notes.title: 🐕 NZ + AU Dog Quarantine
notes.body: Combined ~$6,700 lands in M20–M21. Start the rabies titer blood draw in Tonga (M16) — Australia requires 180 days minimum between titer and arrival. Skip this and the dog flies home alone, or you skip both countries.

notes.title: 💡 Year 3 Is The Cheapest
notes.body: Sri Lanka, Philippines, India, and the Maldives pull Year 3's monthly average below Years 1 and 2 by ~$400/mo. Plan for the Indian Ocean to be where you rebuild any reserve drawn down by Pacific dockage.

notes.title: 🏗️ Three Haul-Outs, Three Strategies
notes.body: Ushuaia (M10) — cheapest yard, pre-Horn imperative. Cairns / Whitsundays (M21) — expensive but the only safe option before Asia. Richards Bay or Durban (M33) — best quality yards on the route. Avoid hauling in French Polynesia at all costs.

notes.title: ⚠️ Cape Horn Buffer — Non-Negotiable
notes.body: The $2,000 in M11 covers weather-window holds, channel beacon damage, sail repair, or a forced retreat. Skipping this buffer is the single most common rookie planning error for southern-route circumnavigators.

notes.title: 🔴 East Africa Routing
notes.body: Never route through the Gulf of Aden. Hug the East African coast south — Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique — and round at Durban. Time the Cape Town departure for April/May before Southern Ocean winter. The Agulhas Current is fast and rough; wait for your window.

notes.title: 🐾 Dog Boarding Abroad
notes.body: Cruiser Facebook groups are the best resource. Book 2+ weeks ahead. Europe and Japan are easy; SE Asia and East Africa require legwork. South American marinas often have staff who'll watch the dog for cash. Bring health records to every booking.

notes.title: 📋 $30K Emergency Reserve
notes.body: Hold $30,000 entirely outside the monthly operating budget. Three years of bluewater sailing will stress every system multiple times — watermaker, sails, engines, dinghy, electronics. The chance of a major unplanned expense over 36 months is effectively 100%.

months.label: Jun
months.summary: Departure month. From Morocco's Atlantic-side ports through the Pillars of Hercules to Spain's Balearics, Provence, and the Tuscan coast. Peak Med season — dockage is expensive but the cruising is unbeatable. First home trip uses up most of the discretionary budget.

months.label: Jul
months.region: Naples · Rome · Florence · Venice · Trieste · Pula
months.summary: The Italian boot and the top of the Adriatic. Naples, Rome (with a Florence side-trip), then north to Venice, Trieste, and the Croatian Istrian peninsula. Old harbors and the wide blue Adriatic in high season.

months.label: Aug
months.summary: Down the Albanian coast and into the Aegean. Athens for the Acropolis, then a slow island-hop south to Heraklion on Crete.

months.label: Sep
months.region: Bodrum · Fethiye · Istanbul · Tunis · Alexandria · Nile
months.summary: Turkey's southwest coast and the Bosphorus, then a long reach across the eastern Med to Tunis and Alexandria. Side-trip up the Nile to Cairo and Luxor. Second home trip departs from Istanbul.

months.label: Oct
months.summary: Reposition west via Madeira and the Canary Islands. Las Palmas is the global pre-crossing waypoint — every cruiser stops here for full tanks, three weeks of provisioning, and a rig check before the trade-wind crossing.

months.label: Nov
months.region: Cape Verde · Equator · Fernando de Noronha
months.summary: The classic trade-wind milk run. ~3,000 nm. Stop in Cape Verde — Mindelo, then Praia — for fuel and fresh produce. The doldrums band requires motoring. Atlantic landfall at Fernando de Noronha.

lines.name: Underway provisioning
lines.note: fresh in Cape Verde, dry stores last

months.label: Dec
months.summary: Brazilian landfall. Salvador is the cultural capital — capoeira, candomblé, and Bahian cooking. Holiday season — third home trip departs from Salvador.

months.label: Jan
months.region: Rio de Janeiro · Ilha Grande · Florianópolis
months.summary: Rio in summer. Glória marina or Ilha Grande anchorages. Brazilian summer extends through February — the cruising is hot, slow, and beautiful.

lines.name: Marina — Glória or Rio yacht clubs

months.label: Feb
months.region: Mar del Plata · Punta del Este · Buenos Aires · Stanley
months.summary: Río de la Plata transit. Buenos Aires for steakhouses and tango, then a long reach south to the Falkland Islands for king penguins and Stanley harbour before the run to Ushuaia.

months.label: Mar
months.summary: Haul-out #1 in the southernmost yard on earth. Refit before the Drake. Cheapest of the three haul-outs. Provision for Antarctica and the Cape Horn rounding.

lines.name: Cape Horn safety gear & rigging check

months.label: Apr
months.region: King George · Deception · Paradise Bay · Port Lockroy
months.summary: An ice-cruise side-trip from Ushuaia, through the Drake Passage to the Antarctic Peninsula. King George Island, the caldera at Deception, Paradise Bay glaciers, and the British base at Port Lockroy. Late season — the window is narrow.

lines.name: Cape Horn emergency reserve
lines.note: weather delays · channel repair · sail damage

months.label: May
months.region: Cape Horn · Patagonian fjords · Puerto Aysén · Valdivia
months.summary: Back through Drake to round Cape Horn proper, then north up the Chilean channels — glaciers, fjords, and the great Patagonian wilderness. Fourth home trip departs from Puerto Aysén or Valdivia (long routing).

months.label: Jun
months.location: Pacific Coast Climb — Chile to Ecuador
months.summary: Cool Humboldt current up the coast. Valparaíso to Lima to Guayaquil, where the route turns offshore for the long arc to Polynesia. Provisioning is good and diesel is reasonable.

months.label: Jul
months.summary: The most remote anchorages on earth. Rapa Nui's moai, the Bounty mutineers' Pitcairn, and Mangareva in the Gambier group. Long, lonely passages — Iridium becomes essential. No home-trip flights available from any of these.

months.label: Aug
months.region: Hiva Oa · Nuku Hiva · Fakarava · Rangiroa
months.summary: Landfall at Hiva Oa is one of cruising's great moments. French Polynesia imposes a cruising bond. Through the Marquesas and into the atolls of the Tuamotus. Fifth home trip via Tahiti.

months.label: Sep
months.region: Bora Bora · Tahiti · Moorea · Huahine · Raiatea
months.summary: Postcard French Polynesia. Mooring fields in Bora Bora are mandatory and expensive. Diving and snorkeling at world-class sites.

months.label: Oct
months.region: Rarotonga · Aitutaki · Niue · Pago Pago · Apia
months.summary: Cook Islands then up to Niue and the Samoas. Pago Pago is the cheap-fuel waypoint of the South Pacific. Sixth home trip via Apia or Honolulu.

months.label: Nov
months.summary: Tonga whale season. CRITICAL: draw rabies titer blood here for NZ/AU quarantine in M20–M21. The 180-day clock starts now.

months.label: Dec
months.region: Yasawa · Suva · Savusavu · Espiritu Santo · Port Vila
months.summary: Fiji has the South Pacific's best diving. Sevusevu kava ceremonies at every village. South to Vanuatu — Tanna's active Mount Yasur volcano, sail up at sunset, watch lava bombs at the rim.

months.label: Jan
months.summary: Strict biosecurity. Dog enters 10-day quarantine. Seventh home trip via Auckland. NZ marina rates are first-world.

months.label: Feb
months.summary: Haul-out #2 in Cairns. Dog enters 10-day AU quarantine. Side-trips south to Sydney and Melbourne by air, then back to the boat for the run north along the Great Barrier Reef. Most expensive single month of the trip.

months.label: Mar
months.summary: Sail across the top of Australia via Torres Strait. Darwin is the staging port for Indonesia, with optional side-trips to Kakadu and a long reposition flight to Perth/Fremantle.

lines.name: AU port fees + Indonesia CAIT prep

months.label: Apr
months.summary: Indonesia is fantastic value. Komodo dragons, Bali culture, Java provisioning. CAIT permit gets you 3 months.

months.label: May
months.summary: Raja Ampat — the global epicenter of marine biodiversity. The Banda Sea and the historic Spice Islands. Eighth home trip via Sorong or Jakarta.

lines.name: Indonesia port fees + Raja Ampat permit

months.label: Jun
months.summary: Up the Malacca Strait — Singapore, Malacca, Langkawi — to Phuket and the Andaman Sea. Diesel and dockage are cheap. The route turns north up the SE Asian peninsula.

lines.name: El Nido island hopping, Coron wrecks

months.label: Jul
months.region: Bangkok · Hạ Long Bay · Da Nang · Saigon
months.summary: Bangkok and the Gulf of Thailand, then around to the Vietnamese coast. Hạ Long Bay's karsts and Saigon's bustle. Ninth home trip via Bangkok or Saigon.

months.label: Aug
months.location: South China Sea — Hainan to Hong Kong
months.summary: Up the Vietnamese coast to Hainan, then Hong Kong with its skyline anchorage. Taiwan transit on the way north — Japan beckons.

lines.name: Food, vet, Japan import cert + titer

months.label: Sep
months.summary: Japan's Ryukyu chain up to Tokyo Bay, with a hop to Incheon for the Korean coast. Marina and diesel are pricey but the welcome is warm. Tenth home trip via Narita.

months.label: Oct
months.summary: Long pivot west from East Asia across the Bay of Bengal. Galle fort marina is the iconic Indian Ocean waypoint. One of the cheapest months of the trip — provisioning and dining are pennies.

months.label: Nov
months.summary: Atoll cruising in the Indian Ocean. Cruising permit covers the whole archipelago. Diving and snorkeling everywhere.

months.label: Dec
months.summary: The Mascarenes — French Creole islands east of Madagascar. Rodrigues, Mauritius, Réunion. Eleventh home trip via Port Louis. Holiday season aboard.

months.label: Jan
months.summary: Across the Mozambique Channel via Madagascar's south coast to the Bazaruto Archipelago and Maputo. Watch the Agulhas Current — the southbound run to South Africa needs a weather window.

months.label: Feb
months.region: Richards Bay · Durban · Port Elizabeth · Cape Town
months.summary: Down the South African east coast — Richards Bay, Durban, Port Elizabeth — to round the Cape and into Cape Town. Haul-out #3 at one of the best yards on the route. Best quality, best price of the three haul-outs.

lines.name: Safari day trip, Stone Town tour

months.label: Mar
months.summary: North up the Namibian coast — Lüderitz to Walvis Bay. Cold, fog, and the Skeleton Coast to seaward. Twelfth and final home trip via Windhoek.

months.label: Apr
months.summary: The closing ocean. Hop St. Helena and Ascension for fuel and a swim. Trade winds carry you back toward South America. Brief landfall at Fernando de Noronha before the final reach to the Caribbean.

months.label: May
months.region: Barbados → Trinidad → Grenada → St Vincent → St Lucia → Martinique → Dominica → Guadeloupe → Antigua → BVI → Jamaica
months.summary: Landfall in Barbados closes the loop. Then a slow chain up through the Lesser Antilles to the BVI, with a final ramble west to Jamaica. Friends and family fly in to celebrate three years of sailing around the world.
